title: City Pop Vinyl Session - 80s Japanese Pop Wave

images.alt_text: City Pop Vinyl Session - 80s Japanese Pop Wave

description:
The Parallel Music Club hosts a vinyl listening session devoted to City Pop, the sound that defined Japanese pop from the late 70s through the 80s. Born out of Japan's economic boom and growing urban confidence, City Pop fused local influences like New Music and Japanese folk rock with Western jazz fusion, disco, soul and synth.

The curation traces the genre's gradual shift from the self-assured, dynamic mood of the 70s to the darker, more doubtful tone of the late 80s, as the economic bubble neared its end. The programme plays full album sides from Taeko Ohnuki's Sunshower, Takako Mamiya's Love Trip and Akina Nakamori's Fushigi, and closes with an open discussion. Food and drinks are not included.
short_description: The Parallel Music Club spins Taeko Ohnuki, Takako Mamiya and Akina Nakamori on vinyl, tracing City Pop's drift from boom-era gloss to late-80s doubt.
